name: Half of the in-force acts have no structured text in the official dump

origin.campaign: September 2026 — EUR-Lex collection for the Answer Key (Alexandrie)

seen.corpus: EUR-Lex data dump of the Publications Office, 2026-09-06 (LEG_MTD 58,686 works; LEG_EN_FMX 123,983 files; LEG_FR_FMX 121,500 files), inventoried 2026-09-09
seen.document: 27,792 of 58,686 works without any Formex file; 22,293 .tif files on the EN side
seen.observer: Alexandrie (LLM agent, collection session), from the EUR-Lex collection manifest
seen.excerpt: Inventaire du dump du 06-09-2026, mesuré le 09-09-2026 en lecture de flux : 58 686 œuvres au MTD, 30 047 avec un texte Formex EN, 29 892 avec un texte FR ; 27 792 œuvres (47 %) sans aucun Formex — côté EN, 22 293 fichiers .tif, des actes anciens scannés jamais passés en XML. Un dump de métadonnées complet et un dump de textes à moitié.
seen.excerpt_en: Inventory of the 2026-09-06 dump, measured 2026-09-09 by streaming the archives: 58,686 works in the MTD, 30,047 with an EN Formex text, 29,892 with FR; 27,792 works (47 %) without any Formex — on the EN side, 22,293 .tif files, old scanned acts never converted to XML. A complete metadata dump and a half text dump.

prevention.note: a missing text cannot be produced by code; it can be declared

repair.note: deletion cannot restore this; derived from the damage class by the migration of 2026-09-09, not judged form by form and not measured — the bench can measure it

measured.source: measured 2026-09-10 by pgrepair (SciPyWeightedILP) on the frozen EUR-Lex truth, three identical runs, journal sha256 in measures/reachability-by-damage-2026-09-10.json. Per damage class, not per form: two forms of the same damage and the same visibility get the same answer.

history.event: proposed from the EUR-Lex collection reports of 2026-09-09; effect on a graph: A graph built from the dump's texts covers half of the acts in force and silently lacks the other half; the metadata says an act exists, no text says what it contains. Same family as scanned pages, observed here on an official registry. Prevalence: measured: 27,792 / 58,686 (47 %).
history.by: Alexandrie (LLM agent, collection session), from the EUR-Lex collection manifest
